title: Welcome
note: Apollo carries the brand in a generous opening moment. The waving pose doubles as the app icon.

title: Privacy introduction
note: Matches the local-first architecture. Network access is isolated to the proposed companion experience.

title: Make it yours
note: Proposed onboarding collects only a name and preferences, without requiring a health profile or account.

title: Permission choices
note: Each permission has a specific purpose. The camera request occurs at the beginning of the heart-rate flow.

title: Today / home
note: A data-first home: latest reading, quality, timestamp, activity, and a clear measurement action. No floating mascot.

title: Measurement hub
note: The primary combined check-in solves the exam-order problem. Individual exams remain available.

title: Activity detail
note: The current prototype’s counters are session/day-baseline limited. The UI does not present them as complete imported activity history.

title: Journal
note: Proposed v1 journal. The character appears inside an invitation, rather than covering app content.

title: Journal composer
note: Mood, text, and tags use lightweight input controls. In this pitch, saving demonstrates the confirmation state.

title: Trends overview
note: Proposed v1 trend screen. Chart ranges are personal history, not diagnostic thresholds.

title: Heart-rate history
note: A detail drilldown keeps provenance, timestamps, and signal quality close to the values.

title: Apollo conversation
note: Companion is a dedicated surface reached through contextual links. No persistent bottom-right mascot.

title: Temperature / introduction
note: Maps to FeverActivity.showIntro: 60-second pre-hold and 90-second screen-to-forehead contact.

title: Phone readiness
note: Readiness reflects ThermalMonitor: drift, temperature, charging/power changes, and recent torch use.

title: Cooling / blocked state
note: Blocked until ThermalMonitor actually reports READY. This approximate cooldown is example UI, not a promise of readiness after a fixed timer.

title: 60-second preparation
note: PREHOLD state: exactly 60 seconds. The preview step is a presentation control; native progression is timed.

title: 90-second forehead contact
note: The live contact screen is dark and touch-locked, matching FeverActivity. Voice and vibration carry the experience. Use the pitch arrows to preview the next state.

title: Temperature / analysis
note: ANALYZING state follows capture. Illustration stays quiet; no fabricated live temperature value.

title: Temperature / result
note: Matches FeverAnalysis.correctedCPerMin. There is no fabricated 36.8 °C phone estimate.

title: Thermometer reference
note: Maps to the optional ref_c field. This illustrative 36.8 °C is explicitly external, not a phone-derived body temperature.

title: Temperature / unreliable
note: An unreliable research session stays clearly labeled; no large result is shown as trustworthy.

title: Heart rate / introduction
note: Matches HeartRateActivity: camera + flash, light pressure, full coverage, and 20 seconds of steady capture.

title: Temperature-first prompt
note: Preserves the existing maybeTemperatureFirst choice in a calmer bottom sheet.

title: Camera permission
note: Shows when the OS permission should appear. Native Android renders the real system dialog.

title: Finger placement
note: Based on CoverageView’s tiled coverage and directional hints. Uncovered areas get a non-color-only label.

title: Signal settling
note: SETTLING is distinct from camera coverage. The real camera waits for a stable, locked exposure before capture.

title: 20-second heart-rate capture
note: 20-second capture uses an optical PPG waveform, not an ECG illustration. BPM appears only after analysis.

title: Heart rate / analysis
note: Camera and flash are stopped before analysis. The phone then enters the thermal cooldown window.

title: Heart rate / result
note: The successful report keeps signal quality and measurement context prominent. No diagnostic label or fabricated normal range.

title: Weak signal / retry
note: Matches the POOR verdict in HeartRateActivity: never show an unreliable BPM number large.

title: Watch comparison
note: Matches ref_bpm entry. The prototype supports manually comparing the camera estimate with a Fitbit.

title: Today / first reading
note: An empty home does not fabricate health values. Apollo makes the first step approachable.

title: Companion / offline
note: Reflects the design’s network boundary: chat needs connectivity; local health features remain usable.

title: Temperature unavailable
note: UNSUPPORTED sensor/setup state. Technical setup stays in device details, away from the everyday measurement journey.

title: Camera access denied
note: Permission denial has a clear route to settings and a route back to the rest of the app.

title: Exam interrupted
note: Represents onPause and Back cancellation in both activities, without claiming an incomplete capture is a valid result.

title: Journal / saved
note: Proposed local-save confirmation. All data in this pitch is illustrative; the design does not write to the native app.

title: Settings
note: Proposed settings entry point. Detailed raw logs and development configuration remain outside normal exam screens.

title: Privacy & data
note: Data deletion is gated behind a dedicated confirmation screen. This mockup never touches native data.

title: Export data
note: Proposed export UI. The demonstration download is clearly labeled and contains only synthetic data.

title: Delete confirmation
note: Explicit destructive-action confirmation, with keeping data as the primary action.
